description: Land Reform Commission -The Statutory Determination made to determine the portion of agricultural land which the statutory Lessee, Late Mr. Gamini Corea should be allowed to retain and an erratum of the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. 1956/08 of 29.02.216
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns statutory determinations under the Land Reform Law regarding agricultural land ownership, specifically addressing land vesting in the Land Reform Commission and the retention of land portions by an estate. The content primarily deals with land registration, ownership transfers, and property descriptions, fitting the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
